content_of_post_to_comment: A few years ago, when someone wanted to scam you with some coach pseudo-babble, they would throw in "according to quantum physics…" now the go-to term of authority is "according to neuroscience." What will be the next one?
comment: The interesting shift is that the jargon changes faster than the underlying tactic: borrowing the prestige of a field to avoid scrutiny. The next authority term may matter less than why we keep trusting labels over evidence.
